Forced three-row paging completed in 48 geometry pages; all 184 fresh native-id reads reproduced geometry; explicit absence, full footprint lookup and complete proposal binding passed. The WUP-containing native parcel 5211850 also matched its prior full geometry. GEOS in EPSG:32760 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The shared Wellington runtime settings are retained. Current primary parcels only; non-primary interests, historic/pending parcels, whole-city completeness, source publication freshness and identity continuity after revision remain unverified. Retain LINZ attribution and CC BY 4.0 conditions; source accuracy notices remain informational.
